title: Kill Switch
description: Super hardcore! When a single player dies, your entire server will shut down! Developed in collaboration with Potatoes_Duck
body:
# Killswitch (working title: DontdieplayersMod)

Every player's life is hooked directly to the server's lifeline so that when a single player dies, the entire server shuts down immediately. There are no respawns and no second chances. The moment any player takes fatal damage, the mod detects the death event and instantly executes a server stop command, ending the session for everyone.
